info.title: CamillaGUI
info.description: The API between the CamillaGUI backend and its frontend. It is internal to the GUI and changes with it, so it has no version of its own.

get.summary: The VU levels, as a stream of `levels` events.
get.description:
The stream has its own subscription, which ends when the browser closes
the stream. Smoothing and rate come from the settings.

200.description: A `levels` event for each update from CamillaDSP

503.description: CamillaDSP cannot be reached, or the level stream is disabled in the settings

get.summary: The spectrum, as a stream of `spectrum` events.
get.description:
The stream has its own subscription, which ends when the browser closes
the stream. The parameters come in the query string, since an EventSource
can only GET.

schema.description:
Side selector for spectrum analysis commands.

Serialised as a lowercase string: `"playback"` or `"capture"`.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel to analyze. `null` averages all channels; an integer selects a single channel (zero-based).

parameters.name: min_freq
parameters.description: Lower edge of the frequency range in Hz. Must be > 0.

parameters.name: max_freq
parameters.description: Upper edge of the frequency range in Hz. Must be > `min_freq`.

parameters.name: n_bins
parameters.description: Number of output bins. Must be ≥ 2.

parameters.name: max_rate
parameters.description: Maximum push rate in Hz. `None` = natural rate (one push per 50 % overlap hop).

200.description: A `spectrum` event for each update from CamillaDSP

503.description: Processing is not running, CamillaDSP cannot be reached, or the level stream is disabled in the settings

get.summary: The processing state, as a stream of `state` events.
get.description:
The stream has its own subscription, which ends when the browser closes
the stream. It starts with the current state.

200.description: A `state` event with the current state, then one for each change

get.summary: The values the GUI polls for, and the versions.
get.description: CamillaDSP is asked at most once a second, however many browsers poll.

AsyncPolyInterpolation.description: Polynomial interpolation order for the async polynomial resampler.

AsyncSincInterpolation.description: Sinc interpolation quality for the async sinc resampler.

AsyncSincParameters.description: Parameters for the async sinc resampler: either a named profile or free parameters.

AsyncSincProfile.description: Preset quality profile for the async sinc resampler.

AsyncSincWindow.description: Window function used by the async sinc resampler.

BiquadComboParameters.description: Multi-section biquad combination type (crossover, EQ, tilt, …).

BiquadParameters.description: Biquad filter type and its frequency/gain/Q parameters.

control_port.description: Port of the test control socket, see `src/dummy_backend/control.rs`.

capture.description: Labels for capture channels. Same structure as `playback`.

playback.description:
Labels for playback channels. `null` if no labels are configured. Each entry is a label
string, or `null` if that specific channel has no label.

CompressorParameters.description: Parameters for the dynamic range compressor processor.

Configuration.description: A complete CamillaDSP configuration: devices, filters, mixers, processors, and the pipeline.

ConvParameters.description: Source of convolution coefficients for the FFT convolution filter.

ConvParametersRaw.description: Coefficients loaded from a raw binary or text file.

ConvParametersWav.description: Coefficients loaded from a specific channel of a WAV file.

DelayUnit.description: Unit for a time or distance value used by delays (Delay filter, RACE processor).

Devices.description: Top-level device and pipeline timing configuration.

chunksize.description: Number of frames per processing chunk.

DiffEqParameters.description: Parameters for the difference-equation (IIR) filter: `a` (feedback) and `b` (feedforward) coefficients.

DitherParameters.description: Dithering algorithm and bit depth for the dither filter.

FileSampleFormat.description: Sample format used for coefficient files; extends [`BinarySampleFormat`] with a plain-text variant.

Filter.description: Filter type selector; each variant carries its own parameter struct.

GainParameters.description: Parameters for the static gain filter.

GainScale.description: Whether a gain value is interpreted as a linear factor or in decibels.

GeneralNotchParams.description: Parameters for the general (asymmetric pole/zero) notch biquad.

GraphicEqualizerParameters.description: Parameters for the graphic equalizer biquad combo filter.

LookaheadLimiterProcessorParameters.description: Parameters for the multichannel lookahead limiter processor.

LoudnessFader.description: Which fader drives the loudness filter's compensation level.

LoudnessParameters.description: Parameters for the loudness (Fletcher-Munson) compensation filter.

Mixer.description: Configuration for a named mixer: channel counts, routing rules, and optional labels.

MixerChannels.description: Input and output channel counts for a mixer.

MixerMapping.description: Routing rule: which sources feed a given destination channel in a mixer.

MixerSource.description: One input source contributing to a mixer output channel.

NoiseGateParameters.description: Parameters for the noise gate processor.

NotchWidth.description: Notch / allpass / bandpass width specified either as a Q factor or a bandwidth in octaves.

PeakingWidth.description: Peaking filter width specified either as a Q factor or a bandwidth in octaves.

PeqBand.description:
One band of an NPointPeq parametric equalizer.

The role of a band follows its position in the list: the first one is a low shelf,
the last one a high shelf, and the ones in between are peaking filters.

PipelineStep.description: One step in the processing pipeline: a mixer, filter chain, or processor.

PipelineStepFilter.description: Configuration for a filter pipeline step.

PipelineStepMixer.description: Configuration for a mixer pipeline step.

PipelineStepProcessor.description: Configuration for a processor pipeline step.

use_rf64.description:
Write an RF64 header so the file can grow past the 4 GB limit of plain
wav. Only applies when `wav_header` is true; ignored otherwise.

control_port.description: Port of the test control socket, see `src/dummy_backend/control.rs`.

oneOf.description:
Sample format to convert each chunk to before discarding it.

Without one the audio is dropped as it arrives, which is cheaper. With one the
device converts the way a real one does on its way to the hardware, which is
where clipping happens and where `clipped_samples` comes from.

ProcessingState.description: The state of the processing, as reported by [`WsCommand::GetState`].

Processor.description: Processor type selector; each variant carries its own parameter struct.

RACEParameters.description: Parameters for the RACE (Recursive Ambiophonic Crosstalk Elimination) processor.

oneOf.description: Async polynomial resampler (low CPU, moderate quality).
Synchronous FFT resampler for fixed integer ratios.

Slip resampler for compensating small clock drift at equal nominal rates.

Very low CPU, rate-adjustable, and adds no delay or high-frequency roll-off.
It only handles ratios close to 1.0, so it cannot convert between different
capture and playback sample rates.

ShelfSteepness.description: Shelf steepness specified either as a Q factor or a slope in dB/octave.

oneOf.description: Sine wave at `freq` Hz and `level` dBFS.
Square wave at `freq` Hz and `level` dBFS.

Signal.description: Signal type generated by the `SignalGenerator` capture device.

frequencies.description: Center frequency of each output bin in Hz.

magnitudes.description: Per-bin peak magnitude in dBFS (0 dBFS = full-scale sine wave).

Status.description:
What `GET /api/status` answers. The processing state is not here, it comes
from `/api/state` as it changes. A value CamillaDSP declines to give, for
example with no config loaded, is null, and so is every value while it is
offline.

capturerate.description:
The capture rate in Hz, rounded to the nearest standard rate. Null when
it is not within 4% of one.

cdsp_online.description: Whether CamillaDSP answered the last time it was asked.

cdsp_version.description: CamillaDSP's version, `(offline)` until it has been reached.

oneOf.description: Processing is still running; not yet stopped.
Processing completed normally (e.g. end of file input).
Capture device sample rate changed to the given value.

CaptureFormatChange.description: Capture device sample rate changed to the given value.

oneOf.description: Playback device sample rate changed to the given value.

PlaybackFormatChange.description: Playback device sample rate changed to the given value.

TimeUnit.description: Unit for a time value (attack, release, envelope times).

VolumeFader.description: Which aux fader a Volume filter is linked to (faders 1–4; the main fader is always 0).

VolumeParameters.description: Parameters for the volume-ramp filter linked to a specific fader.

VuLevels.description:
Payload of a [`WsReply::VuLevelsEvent`] pushed by [`WsCommand::SubscribeVuLevels`].

All values are smoothed dB levels, per channel.
